tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /skyes mchog rnams la gdams pa'i skor bzhugs so// gzhon nu kun rgyal la gdams pa rang mtshang sgrog pa'i sprin gyi rnga gsang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rdo rje 'dzin dngos blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'jam dbyangs bla ma rje/ /'gro ba'i rtsa lag pha gcig dge ba'i bshes/ /'dren mchog bla ma rnams la gus btud nas/ /dga' bskyed yul lnga'i pad tshal rgyas pa ru/ /gang zhig 'dod pa'i sbrang rtsi don gnyer nas/ /yid kyi sbrang ma rnam par 'khyams pa yi/ /snying gi bu la gdams pa bshad kyis nyon/ /mkhas shing lang tsho gsar pa'i nyi gzhon de/ /khengs dregs shing rta'i bzhon pa la brten nas/ /lugs zung lha yi rdzing ring brgal ba'i tshe/ /nyes ltung sgra gcan gdug pas zos pa mtshar/ /nyam thag 'byor bas phongs pa'i 'gro ba yis/ /'dod dgu sbyin pa'i gter bzang thob pa ltar/ /da lta'i rnyed dka'i mi lus rin chen 'di/ /rnam g.yeng ngang du ma gtong snying gi bu/ /pad sdong 'dar ba'i 'dab rtse'i chu thigs bzhin/ /tshe 'di yun ring gnas pa'i gdeng med cing / /sang dang phyi ma'i snga phyi rnyed dka' bas/ /nam 'chi cha med soms shig snying gi bu/ /gling bzhi'i bdag po'i 'byor pa thob gyur kyang / /rnam par dpyad na snying po ma mchis na/ /da lta'i dpon tsam ji ltar 'bad pas skyongs/ /tshe 'di blo yis thongs shig snying gi bu/ /da lta lhan du tshogs pa'i mi rnams kyang / /gang tshe las kyis so sor 'bral ba na/ /cha rgyus med pa'i yul du gcig pur 'gro/ /nye du'i kha 'dzin skyur cig snying gi bu/ /khyod dang yud tsam 'bral bar mi bzod pa'i/ /yul la mngon par chags pa'i grogs bzang gis/ /yang yang bslus pas da dung srid par 'khyams/ /las bskos 'di dag brjed dam snying gi bu/ /gnyen dang grogs la chags pa'i bdud po 'dis/ /ltar snang phan pa sgrub pa'i bslu brid kyis/ /brtse med gshin rje'i lag tu sprad kyis dogs/

/gcig pur ri khrod grims shig snying gi bu/ /rkyen gyis bslus tshe chags sdang bdud po 'dis/ /lo mang sgrub pa byas pa'i rtogs ldan yang / /brlag par 'gyur na khyod lta smos ci 'tshal/ /rang sems yan par ma gtong snying gi bu/ /rang don bsgrub phyir gzhan mgo skor du re/ /rang skyon sba zhing chos srid skyong 'dod nas/ /g.yo chen brdzun gyis gzhan dag bslu byed pa'i/ /khram pa de 'dra ma byed snying gi bu/ /skyo shas skyes kyang rang khyim dam du bzung / /bya btang lags mod dpon sde'i kha 'dzin byas/ /'chi ba dran yang tshe 'di'i che thabs sgrub/ /chos pa ngo mtshar che'o snying gi bu/ /chags pas bcing bas ji byas tshe 'dir song / /khro bas rbad nas grogs rnams sun par byas/ /rmongs pas bslus pas blang dor brjed nas 'dug /bdag yid skyo bar gyur to snying gi bu/ /nges 'byung rwa gdengs rdo rje'i gur khang gi /phyi rol sgrub pa'i me dpung 'bar ba ru/ /'chi ba dran pa'i bden pas myur khug la/ /zhen pa'i bdud po sregs shig snying gi bu/ /da ni yun ring e sdod mi shes pas/ /dpon chas brlag kyang 'jig rten bya ba spong / /sring mo 'khyal yang 'gyod pa mi bya bar/ /tshe lhag chos la spyod cig snying gi bu/ /gang zhig snying rje'i rtsa ba nyams dmas shing / /sbyin sogs thabs mang rkyen gyis bor gyur bas/ /gzhan phan sems mchog ljon pa nyams nas song / /ris bral brtse ba sgoms shig snying gi bu/ /bdag lta'i khang bzang nyams dgar gnas bcas shing / /rnam g.yeng dga' mar 'dod pa'i zur mig g.yo/ /rnam mang rtog pa'i bya bas dub gyur pas/ /lta ba'i ngal gso sten cig snying gi bu/ /gang zhig grags snyan 'dod pa'i sprin gseb nas/ /zol med rnam dag dam chos sgrub bo zhes/ /sgra chen bsgrags pa nam mkha'i dbyings su dengs/ /kha zhe mtshungs gin mi 'dug snying gi bu/ /grags 'dod bcos ma'i ngom chos tsam zhig las/

/sdom gsum bslab bya'i tshogs rnams yal bar bor/ /dam tshig mngon lkog byed pa'i tshul 'chos mkhan/ /rang zhe rang la khrel lam snying gi bu/ /sngar byas sdig la 'gyod par mi 'gyur la/ /phyin chad sdom pa'i dam bca' ma mchis shing / /rnam par g.yeng ba'i sgom bzlas sgrib pa yi/ /gnyen por song ba med do snying gi bu/ /sngon tshe dal 'byor rten bzang sbyin pa'i ma/ /'chi bdag rgyal po'i khrims sar khrid pa'i tshe/ /bu 'dis dam pa'i chos shig 'grub re ba'i/ /a ma'i zhal chems dran nam snying gi bu/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'jam dbyangs bla ma las/ /yang gsang bla na med pa'i zab chos thos/ /rna ba'i dbang po skal pa bzang lags kyang / /nyams len med pas 'gyod do snying gi bu/ /khyod kyis dam pa du ma'i spyan snga ru/ /sems dpa' yis kyang spyad par dka' ba yi/ /don gnyis bsgrub ces dam bca'i khur chen po'i/ /khas blangs ral bar shes sam snying gi bu/ /bag med sprin las nyes pa'i char 'bab pas/ /sdig ltung ba tshwa'i rgya mtsho rnam par 'phel/ /bzod dka' ngan 'gro'i g.yang sar khyer gyis dogs/ /tsha grang sdug bsngal soms shig snying gi bu/ /da lta nyin gcig bkres pa'i sdug bsngal tsam/ /bzod pa'i nus pa khyod la ma mchis na/ /'jigs chen nad kyis shin tu nyam thag tshe/ /sran pa'i blo stobs yod dam snying gi bu/ /nam zhig las rlung drag pos rgyab nas ded/ /'jigs rung gshin rje'i pho nyas mdun nas khrid/ /thar med dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal snying la 'char/ /de tshe mgon skyabs med do snying gi bu/ /lcags sreg sa gzhir gcer bu ngu zhing rgyug /sha rus lpags pa'i tshogs rnams 'bar zhing bsreg /rngams 'jigs gshin rjes dral zhing gtub pa'i tshe/ /de na gnyen bshes med do snying gi bu/ /'khyag rum sa gzhir gangs ri'i phreng bas bskor/ /kha ba bu yug 'tshubs shing grang bas gdung / /kyi hud la sogs skad ngan sgrog pa'i dus/

/nam 'ong nges pa med do snying gi bu/ /me mur 'obs dang ro myag 'dam du bying / /ral gris gtub cing spu gri'i thang du 'gyel/ /rab med chu bo brgal yang thar dus med/ /mi 'jigs dpa' bar sems sam snying gi bu/ /ji ltar tshes pa'i dus kyi zla ba ltar/ /rnam dag chos pa'i dge blo 'phel nas 'gro/ /khyod kyi lhag bsam mar ngo bzhin du 'grib/ /las kyis mnar 'di mthong ngam snying gi bu/ /rnam dag tshul khrims gtsang ma'i rta bzhon nas/ /bde mchog thar pa'i gling du 'gro ba la/ /sgo gsum bag med chang gis myos gyur nas/ /rdo rje dmyal ba'i g.yang sar ltung la nye/ /rang mtshang mthong nas 'gyod par gyur na yang / /rang dbang med pas da gzod ngan 'gror 'gro/ /rang gis rang nyid bslus pa 'di dran tshe/ /rang srog rang gis bcad kyang phangs pa med/ /ston mchog thugs rje'i bstan pa'i rjes zhugs shing / /yongs 'dzin du ma'i zhabs rdul bsten pa'i mthus/ /sdug bsngal mtha' can zhig tu gyur na yang / /'jigs rung g.yang sa dran tshe mchi ma 'chor/ /zab rgyas gzhung mang mthong tshe blo mig zum/ /smra brjod nyung zhing snyom las mal du nyal/ /srid pa bsgrubs na lce bde blo gros gsal/ /ma rabs skye bo skal dman khyod 'dra su/ /dal 'byor lus la bslab gsum rgyan spras shing / /gtan bde'i grogs po 'tshol du phyin pa na/ /rnam par g.yeng ba'i dgra bo dpung bcas kyis/ /kye ma chos kyi rgyan bzang 'phrog la ltos/ /da ni kho bo sdom gsum nor gyis phongs/ /bcas dang rang bzhin ltung ba'i khur khur nas/ /grogs med gcig pur nyam nga'i lam der 'gro/ /bdag ni lhar bcas 'gro ba'i snying rje'i yul/ /dman pa bdag la thos pa'i nor med cing / /ngo tsha'i gos dang khrims kyi bzhon pa bral/ /blo gros mig ldongs sgom pa'i zas kyis phongs/ /gcer bu legs pa'i yon tan kun gyis dben/ /kye ma tshul min yid byed lto ba yangs/

/'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho rnam par 'phel/ /zhe sdang mi gtsang 'dam gyis gang zhing 'thor/ /gti mug lpags pas rnam par bsgribs nas yod/ /bstan pa nub cing bstan 'dzin mchog rnams gshegs/ /ston pas bcas pa sgrub pa phal cher zad/ /bdag sogs bstan bshig du ma deng sang 'phel/ /sngon gyi legs byas dman pa da gzod go /mdor na phyugs dang khyad par ma mchis pa'i/ /blun rmongs bdag kyang rang gi tshul 'di la/ /cung zad skyo bar gyur na brtse ldan pa'i/ /mkhas rnams smos kyang ci dgos grogs po dag /kho bo 'chi ba'i dus la bab gyur nas/ /srog gi dbang po 'gag la nye ba'i dus/ /rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs nus na/ /de tshe thugs rje'i lcags kyus ma gtong zhig /gal te las kyis dmyal bar 'tshed gyur na/ /khyed kyi mthu stobs thogs pa ma mchis pas/ /'dren pa mchog gis thugs rje'i phyag brkyangs nas/ /nyam thag bdag gi sdug bsngal bsal du gsol/ /bla ma mchog las re sa bdag la med/ /rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /'di dang phyi ma bar do'i gnas rnams su/ /e ma skyobs shig skyobs shig bka' drin can/ /snying rje'i gter chen bla ma snying nas bsten/ /snying po'i gdams pa snying gtam tshul du gsungs/ /snying gi bcud du bzung ba'i snying nor 'di/ /snying gi bu la snying du bsams nas gtad/ /gzhon nu gzhon nu'i bya bas g.yeng ba la/ /brtse chen brtse ba drag pos ma bzod nas/ /blo ldan blo yis bshes gnyen bskul ba las/ /legs byung legs par bshad pa'i gtam 'di 'o/ /ma chags tshe 'dir zhen pa gting nas chod/ /ma sdod gcig pur dben pa'i ri la byon/ /ma brjed a ma'i zhal chems snying la chongs/ /ma yengs dam pa'i lha chos myur du mdzod/ /tshul 'di gzhon nu kun dga'i rnam thar la/ /yid 'byung gting nas skyes pa'i snyoms las pa/ /bslab gsum rgyal po'i khrims kyis ma thul ba'i/

/pho rgod blo gros mi zad ces byas sbyar// //dge'o// ༈ /skyes dang sbyangs pa'i blo gros mi dman zhing / /tshul khrims rnam gsum srog pas gces par srung / /rtse gcig sgrub la gzhol ba'i nan tan can/ /snying dang 'dra ba'i grogs khyod yud tsam dgongs/ /khyod kyis na bza' sogs spong dag mdzad nas rnyed bkur dang du mi len par/ 'dod yon la rgyab kyis phyogs te dka' spyad drag pos byang chub sgrub pa ni ngo mtshar che/ bdag kyang rjes su yi rang / 'on kyang kha zas dang spyod lam ha cang dam che nas gnang bkag gi dus tshod ma shes par 'byung ba snyom pa'i kha zas spangs pas lus srog gi bar chad du gyur na tshul khrims dka' spyad kyi bdud zer ba yin/ de bzhin du lus la nad zhugs kyang gnyen po zas dang sman sogs mi bsten pa 'dug pa la bzod pa sran tshugs kyi bdud zer ba yin/ dge sbyor ha cang grim ches pas khams kyis ma thub nas blo sun te phyir log brgyabs pa la brtson 'grus thang chad kyi bdud zer ba yin pas nyid kyis 'tsho ba ha cang zhen du ma 'jug lags/ nyid kyi thugs la gshin gson gyi dad rdzas 'di nyes pa shin tu che bas de za ba las cung zad ltogs na dga' dgongs pa yin tshod 'dra bas/ gshin zas de nyid kyis ma gsol kyang chog par 'dug gzhan gson po'i sku rim sogs la 'ong ba'i chos mthun gyi rnyed pa cung zad re blangs nas chos sgrub pa'i rten 'tsho ba dang / lus kyi srin 'bu gso ba sogs la dgongs nas gsol bcas legs po re mdzad na de tsam skrag mi dgos te/ ji skad du/ lus 'di dgra dang 'dra mod kyi/ /de lta na yang de bsrung bya/ /khrims ldan yun ring 'tsho ba ni/ /de las bsod nams chen po 'byung / /zhes dang / gzhan las kyang de 'dra ba mang du gsungs shing / theg dman nyan thos kyi lugs la mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba'i zas gos zer ba yin pas kha zas ha cang zhan che na ngal zhing dub pa'i mthar lhung ba yin/

theg chen pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs la bsam pa sems bskyed kyis zin na 'dod yon la spyad kyang nyes pa med par gsungs pas/ khyed dus rgyun du mtshams bsnyen sgrub la brtson pa zhig gis thugs bskyed dang bsngo ba re mdzad na chos mthun gyi kha zas tsam la rang gzhan gnyis ka'i tshogs rdzogs pa'i mthun rkyen du 'gyur ba las dkor sgrib cung zad kyang 'byung don mi 'dug khyad par du gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lugs la ni/ 'jug pa bde ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /gsang sngags rgyal po tshe 'dir 'grub/ /ces zer ba yin pas sgo gsum rdo rje gsum dang mi 'bral bar snang ba dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor shes pa'i gdeng zhig yod na 'dod yon la ji ltar spyad kyang nyes pa med par ma zad rtogs pa'i bogs 'don du 'gyur ba yin mod/ de gang zag rab kyi spyod yul yin pas de 'dra mi nus dgongs na/ nyid kyis kha zas kyi bya ba mdzad pa'i dus na/ mkha' spyod ma'i bla mchod nas 'byung ba'i kha zas kyi rnal 'byor de'am/ gzhan kye rdor gyi rnam bshad rnams na kha zas kyi rnal 'byor rgyas bsdus du ma zhig 'dug pa de rnams las thugs la gang mos shig lag len la 'debs par mdzod dang / des kha zas tsam la dkor sgrib med par ma zad tshogs rdzogs pa'i rkyen du 'gyur ba ni rgyal ba'i bka' bla ma'i lung zer ba yin pas de la the tshom mdzad mi dgos/ 'o na dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mdo las/ thub pas dad rdzas zos pa'i nyes pa gsungs pa na de la skrag nas dge slong lnga brgyas bslab pa phul te khyim par babs pa la ston pas legs so gnang nas ma 'ongs pa na byams pa'i 'khor du lung bstan pa min nam zhe na/ yin mod de'i dgongs gzhi sngon thub pa bzhugs pa'i dus na dge 'dun phal cher 'phags pa'i gang zag yin cing / sbyin bdag rnams kyang las 'phro dang skal pa mi dman pas dad gus shin tu che bas de'i dbang gis gos ngur smrig 'chang ba thams cad la 'phags pa dngos kyi 'du shes kyis bkur sti byed pa yin/

des na so skye'i dge 'dun la 'phags pa'i gang zag tu bzung nas yon phul ba na de shes bzhin du dang du blang ba la nyes pa 'byung ba'am/ sbyin bdag khyad par can rnams kyis gtan gyi skyabs gnas su bzung nas bkur sti byed pa'i yul de dag la 'jigs skyob dang legs smon gyi tshul khrims tsam las med pa sogs la dgongs sam snyam pa dang / dgos pa nges 'byung gi bsam pas ma zin pa'i tshul khrims tsam mam/ ngag nus cung zad re yod pa sogs yon tan sna re dang ldan yang dad rdzas blang du mi rung bar go ba dang / deng sang gi skye bo rang rgyud na lung rtogs kyi yon tan spu tsam med cing / sha'i tsho rdzud dang thud kyi srab mthug la thugs dam byed pa/ nor rdzas kyi ched du spyang ki zas tshol du zhugs pa ltar rgyu ba rnams kyis/ gshin gson gyi dad rdzas bag med du spyod pa dgag pa'i don du 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams kyis tshul bstan de 'dra zhig gnang ba yin nam snyam ste/ gal te min na so skye'i dge 'dun yon gnas su mi 'gyur zhing / der ma zad sku tshe gcig la dge slong gi bslab bya phra rags thams cad tshul bzhin du srung ba'i phan yon las/ chos mthun gyi bsod snyoms tsam bzhes pa'i nyes pa che na/ dge slong gi rten la byang chub sgrub pa'i skal pa med par 'gyur te/ dge slong gis gsog 'jog byed mi chog pas rang la ni za rgyu med/ gzhan gyi zas ni blang du mi rung zhing 'dod khams pa yin pas zas gtan nas med na 'tsho mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dge rtsa yongs su sbyong ba'i mdo las/ ldan dang grol la nga yis gnang ba ste/ /zhes tshul khrims dang ldan pas dad rdzas blang du rung bar gsungs shing / gzhan yang / slob pa byin pa spyod pa ste/ /mi slob par ni bdag por spyod/ /lhag ma le los bcom pa yi/ /bdag nyid rnams ni bu lon spyod/ /bsam gtan klog dang ldan pa ni/ /rjes gnang spyod pas nyes pa med/

/ces klog spong gi las la brtson na ston pas rjes su gnang ba yin pas nyes pa med par gsungs la/ lar ston pa'i rjes 'jug rnams kyis thub pa'i sngon gyi skyes rabs dang cha mthun pa zhig dgos la sngon gyi skyes rabs phal cher na rnyed bkur dang 'dod yon la rgyab kyis phyogs nas dben par bsam gtan la gzhol bar mdzad pa ni du ma zhig 'dug kyang / dben par bzhugs pa'i dus na chos mthun gyi rnyed pa re 'bul mkhan byung tshe khong gi chos kyi mthun rkyen dang / pha rol po'i tshogs rdzogs pa'i rkyen du 'gyur ba las/ dkor sgrib la skrag nas ma bzhes pa mi dran pas/ a tsa ras rta zhon pa lta bu'i dge sbyor de bar chad du 'gro nyen che bas ha cang gu dog ma mdzad rogs sku tshe ring / 'tsho ba zhan pa'i stobs kyis lus kyi 'byung khams rgud nas nad gzhi chen po re'i rgyur e 'gyur go dka' bas de lugs mdzod/ 'o na rje btsun mi la dang / grub thob me long rdo rje sogs kyis dka' spyad mdzad pa ma mthong ngam zhe na/ mthong mod khong rnams srid pa tha ma pa yin pas gzhan dang mi 'dra/ kha zas med rung ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis lus 'tsho nus pa yin/ der ma zad rje mi las kyang / brag la sgom pa'i sgom chen dang / /'tsho ba sbyor ba'i yon bdag gnyis/ /'tshang mnyam por rgya ba'i rten 'brel yod/ rten 'brel gyi snying po bsngo ba yin/ /zhes yon mchod gnyis ka la phan par gsungs kyi gnod par ma gsungs so/ /lar khyed kyi thugs la zas nor cung zad re phul tshe de la sgrol ma dang skyabs 'gro sogs mang po re bton yod gsungs nas dmigs kyis bkar te bsngo ba dang smon lam mdzad pa de/ khyed kyi thugs la dus rgyun du zhal 'don mdzad pa de rang gi sgrib sbyong yin dgongs nas shin tu smar zhing / skabs skabs su gzhan gyi sku rim mdzad pa la gzhan gyi ched yin dgongs nas cung zad lhod pa'i snang ba zhig e 'dug lags/

yod na thugs rgya cung zad chung ba yin te/ sems bskyed legs po zhig yod nas bzung / rgyun du grong chog sogs la byon kyang rang gi sgrib sbyong du 'gro ba dang / rtse gcig tu sgrub pa la gzhol yang gzhan don kho na zhig dgos pa khyed kyis los mkhyen/ des na bdag med kyi gnas lugs mngon sum du ma rtogs kyi bar du rang don gyi 'khri ba cung zad tsam mi 'byung ba dka' rung / 'di nga'i yin de gzhan gyi yin zer nas nor rdzas bgo ba ltar mi mdzad par/ dge ba gang bsgrubs blos ling gis btang ste/ dmigs yul gyis thog drangs pa'i sems can spyi la bsngo smon re mdzad nas rang don gyi zhen pa ci chod da lta nas mdzad dgos pa ma yin nam/ lar mthun rkyen re 'bul mkhan byung tshe/ a la re dga' sems can 'di dang nged gnyis la chos mthun gyi 'brel ba legs po zhig zhog byung / ma 'ongs pa na ngas 'di'i don byed par nus so snyam pa de/ sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa rnams la nges par dgos te/ tshogs rdzogs/ zhing sbyangs/ gdul bya smin par byas nas sangs rgyas dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /da dung zhu rgyu mang po zhig 'dug rung / yi ges 'jigs pas de tsam las ma spros so/ /'dir smras pa/ sdom pa gsum la srung sdom ma nus shing / /zab mo'i lam la nyams len mi byed par/ /rgyun du bag med spyod pas dus 'da' ba/ /bdag las skal pa ngan pa su zhig yod/ /des na slad tsha'i rdul mang spungs pa la/ /yid dang mthun pa'i dri zhim med pa ltar/ /skyon brgya tshang ba'i skye bo bdag 'dra las/ /legs bshad 'byung ba shin tu dka' na yang / /rang gzhan grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i mthar son pa/ /smra ba'i dbang po gzhan phan chos rje las/ /zab rgyas gzhung mang yang yang thos pa'i phyir/ /go yul tsam du blang dor phyogs tsam shes/ /des na khyod la gsol ba'i don de kun/ /rang la nyams myong med pa'i bshad yam tsam/ /lags mod yid ches lung dang mi 'gal bas/

/shes med blun po'i kha ta lta bu min/ /sna tshogs spyod ngan rgyan du 'dzin pa yi/ /ma rabs skye bo bdag 'dra'i kha sgo las/ /thon pa'i tshig kyang bla ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /nyid kyi thugs la cis kyang cag par zhu/ /legs bshad yin na byis pa'i ngag las kyang / /blang 'os yin zhes mkhas rnams gsungs pa'i phyir/ /rmongs pa bdag gis 'chal gtam sgrogs pa yang / /chos dang mthun na khyed kyis len par rigs/ /'di na kun gyis smad pa'i mu to bas/ /rgyal po'i sras la bslab bya ston pa ltar/ /bdag 'dras khyed la gdams ngag sbyin pa ni/ /gzhan gyis khrel bar 'gyur ba'i gnas yin mod/ /ring nas mthun par 'grogs pa'i chos kyi grogs/ /tshe 'di'i spun las lhag pa'i brtse gdung can/ /khyod dang bdag gnyis shin tu snying nye bas/ /ji ltar smras kyang skyon du 'gyur ba min/ /dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ /bar du brtson pas tshogs gnyis legs bsgrubs nas/ /tha mar mngon sangs rgyas ba'i tshul 'di ni/ /rgyal ba'i sras po spyi yi rnam thar yin/ /dang por zla ba du mar bsnyen sgrub mdzad/ /bar du rgyun chad med par dkor la 'byam/ /tha mar gnyen gyi chad pa'i mthar lhung ba/ /grong chog mkhan po'i rnam thar gzigs lags sam/ /dang por dka' ba spyad de za chog bslabs/ /bar du brdzun dang tshong gi 'khor lo bskor/ /tha mar skyong byed rgan po'i tshul 'dzin pa'i/ /a khu'i dal 'byor don yod ma byas so/ /dang por bla ma bsten nas thos pa btsal/ /bar du mchog dman kun la skur pa btab/ /tha mar thams cad dgra ru ldang ba 'di/ /da lta'i thos bsam byas pa'i lag rjes red/ /sum rtsen gnas su rgyu ba'i lha'i bu dag /rtsub 'gyur tshal du zhugs pa ji bzhin du/ /ji tsam mkhas pa'i gzhung la sbyangs pa rnams/ /de tsam gdug rtsub che ba dus kyi skyon/ /gang zhig sol ba'i phung po brten pa'i mi/ /de dag de yi rdul gyis gos pa bzhin/

/log ltas bslad pa'i skye bo gdug pa can/ /brten pa de dag de yi rjes su 'gro/ /dgra bcom mthu ldan gzhan gyi rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /gzhan dag 'chi med lam du 'gro ba bzhin/ /chos mthun skyes bu mchog dang 'grogs pa las/ /'ga' zhig chos kyi 'byor bas phyug par gyur/ /gtsang ma'i zas kyis 'tsho ba'i lha rnams ni/ /mi gtsang dngos po chung yang spong bar byed/ /de bzhin rnam dkar sgrub pa'i dam pa rnams/ /nyes pa chung yang dug bzhin 'dzem par mdzad/ /mi gtsang zas su za ba'i phag pa rnams/ /de la skyon du lta ba med pa ltar/ /dkor nag lan tshwa'i rgya mtshor bying ba 'ga'/ /da dung dkor chus ngoms par ma gyur to/ /bstan pa'i sgor zhugs bstan pa bshig la brtson/ /chos gtam byed bzhin chos min spyod pas g.yengs/ /rang gshis ngan pas rang gzhan phung la sbyor/ /bdag dang bdag 'dra'i gnas skabs de 'drar gyur/ /de slad dus mtha'i skye bo phal mo che'i/ /spyod pa chos dang mthun par ma mthong bas/ /snying nas chos la mos pa'i sdom brtson khyed/ /shin tu skal pa bzang po legs so ang / /grogs mchog khyed kyis tshe 'di blos btang nas/ /rtse gcig sgrub la brtson par mdzad dgongs na/ /man ngag gnad kyis zin pa'i dam chos shig /dgos kyi dka' spyad kho nas grol ba min/ /ston pa mchog la skyabs su mi 'dzin cing / /bstan pa 'di las phyi rol gyur pa yi/ /dka' thub kho nas grol bar 'dod pa dag /zhi ba'i lam dang mthun par ma gzigs nas/ /lha mi'i rnam 'dren shākya'i sras de yis/ /lo drug dka' ba spyad pa'i thabs mkhas kyis/ /nyam nga'i lam du gol ba'i mu stegs byed/ /phal cher yang dag lam la bkod ces thos/ /thabs mkhas 'jug bde rgyal sras lam bzang nas/ /bde mchog chos sku'i rgyal sar gshegs pa'i phyir/ /bde bar gshegs zhes bgyi ba lags pas na/ /nyid kyang bde nas bde bar 'byon par zhu/ /snying dang 'dra ba'i sdom brtson khyod nyid la/

/snying nas gus pa'i sems kyis legs bskul nas/ /snying gtam yi ger bris te phul ba 'di/ /snying gi dkyil du sba bar mdzad du gsol/ /gzhan yang slad ma'i skye ba thams cad du/ /khyod dang bdag gnyis nam yang mi 'bral zhing / /phan tshun dam chos sgrub pa'i grogs gyur te/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di ni sdom brtson dam pa byams pa blo gros phun tshogs la sde gzhung sprul ming kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis nang zhus kyi tshul du spring ba'o// //dge'o// ༈ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum bla ma gtsug tu khur zhing / /sdom gsum mig 'bras bzhin du bsrungs nas/ /sgo gsum spyod pa chos dang mthun pa'i/ /grogs mchog khyed la 'di skad zhu 'o/ /nyin mo skye bo'i 'du tshogs nyung zhing / /mtshan mo sgra yi klag cor med par/ /yengs med brtson pas ting 'dzin sgrub pa/ /dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar lags mod/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma nub rir phebs pas/ /phan bde'i 'od snang nyams la nye zhing / /sna tshogs spyod ngan rgyan du 'dzin pa'i/ /mi bsrun skye bos phyogs kun gang bas/ /nad dang 'khrug rtsod mu ge la sogs/ /sdug bsngal mun pa 'thib pa'i dus 'dir/ /grogs med gcig pu dben pa'i gnas su/ /sgrub tshugs zin pa shin tu dka' bas/ /byams dang snying rjes sems rgyud btul nas/ /thabs mkhas spyod pas grogs dang bstun te/ /'du 'dzi'i 'brel thag ci chod ngang nas/ /gnas der bzhugs pa 'thad dam snyam lags/ /'du 'dzi sdug bsngal rgyu ru mthong ba'i/ /skyo shas gting nas skyes pa med na/ /gang du phyin kyang 'du 'dzi'i dgra las/ /thar bar dka' 'o snying gi grogs po/ /skyid sdug dus skabs bzang ngan sna tshogs/ /'byung ba 'khor ba'i chos nyid lags pas/ /des na grogs khyod gang du bzhugs kyang / /yun ring sdod pa'i dam bca' ma mdzad/ /nag phyogs bdud sde'i mthu dpung dar ba'i/

/cher snyigs rgud pa'i dus ngan 'di na/ /chos mthun bsam pa 'grub par dka' bas/ /lha dang bla mar gsol ba thob mdzod/ /bka' drin sum ldan bla ma mchog la/ /dkon mchog gsum po tshang bar shes pa'i/ /mos gus ngang nas gsol ba btab na/ /bsam don chos bzhin 'grub ces thos so/ /rnam rtog 'khrul pa'i rjes su 'brang na/ /snang ba thams cad dgra ru ldang bas/ /nyams dang rmi lam bzang ngan sogs la/ /re dogs dgag sgrub gang yang ma mdzod/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa mtha' dag /sems nyid 'khrul pa'i snang ba tsam las/ /logs na med pa'i chos nyid shes na/ /bdud kyang chos kyi grogs po yin skad/ /'khor 'das dbyer med lta ba'i klong na/ /'khor 'das chos la spang blang med pas/ /gnyug ma spros bral sems kyi chos nyid/ /yang dag lta la 'dris goms mdzod cig /khyad par rang re mchod grogs thams cad/ /gnas 'dir sdod la bar du gcod pa/ /glo bur dgra snang 'byung ba med pa'i/ /phrin bcol ye shes spyan ras gsal zhing / /rdzu 'phrul myur ba'i zhabs dang ldan pa'i/ /srung ma'i tshogs la zhu ba gal che/ /las ngan bdag gi 'khrul pa'i rtog pa/ /yi ger bris la dgos pa ci yod/ /'on kyang khyod gsung mi ldog tsam du/ /cung zad bris te phul ba de lags/ /ma 'ongs slad ma'i skye ba kun tu/ /lta spyod mthun pa'i grogs su gyur nas/ /byang chub bar du 'grogs nas 'gro bar/ /snying nas smon no snying gi grogs po// //dge'o// ༈ /gang zhig brten na dge legs kun stsol zhing / /dran pas srid zhi'i 'jigs pa sel mdzad pa/ /chos kyi rgyal po dpal mgon bla ma la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /kye lags gang gi 'dren byed sgrib pa'i dri/ /sbyong ba'i thabs tshul zab mo sna tshogs la/ /myur du 'bad pa'i brtson pa ma mdzad na/ /blang dor snang ba'i skabs 'di nyams kyis dogs/ /lhag bsam mchog dang ldan pa'i skyes bu la/

/nag po'i rtsa lag rnams kyis glags btsal bas/ /bsam don thog tu khel ba dka' zhes thos/ /des na bar chad srung ba'i thabs la 'bad/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus dpal ldan bla ma mchog /spyi bor bsgoms shing dad pa'i gdung shugs kyis/ /yang yang snying nas gsol ba 'debs nus na/ /bsam pa'i don kun mi 'grub mi srid do/ /sdug bsngal rang bzhin 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid shes/ /mi rtag nam 'chi cha med snying nas dran/ /dkar nag las 'bras bslu ba med mthong nas/ /rnyed dka'i lus 'di don bcas mdzad par rigs/ /'jigs dad snying rje'i rgyu yis bskul byas te/ /dkon mchog gsum la snying nas skyabs 'gro zhing / /byams dang snying rje'i shugs kyis drangs pa yi/ /byang chub sems mchog lam gyi snying por zungs/ /mthong thos nyal bas grol ba'i 'ud chen gyis/ /thabs shes ya bral gyur pa'i nyams len la/ /bskal brgyar brtson las nges 'byung byang chub sems/ /thun gcig bsgom pa mchog tu bdag gis sems/ /brtson pas dus ring sgrub la gzhol gyur kyang / /gal te chos kyi gnad rnams 'chugs gyur na/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam las ring du 'gyur/ /de phyir gnad kyis zin pa'i dam chos gces/ /de yang nges 'byung chos kyi rtsa ba ste/ /'di bral chos de srid pa'i rgyu ru nges/ /skyabs su 'gro ba chos kyi rten gzhi ste/ /med na sangs rgyas pa yi chos lugs min/ /byang chub sems mchog chos kyi snying po ste/ /'di med gzhan gyis byang chub ji ltar thob/ /rnam dag bsngo ba chos kyi srung ma ste/ /med na dge rtsa rkyen gyis 'joms par 'gyur/ /de bas 'di 'dra'i tshul la dgongs nas ni/ /chos kyi gnad rnams 'phyug pa med par mdzod/ /rgyal bstan snang byed nub ri'i phrag par thon/ /chos mdzad skyes bu nyin skar tsam du bas/ /mi bsrun skye bos phyogs kun khyab gyur cing / /chos mthun zas gos 'byor pas phongs dus 'dir/

/sngon gyi thub pa dag gi brtul zhugs bzhin/ /dben pa'i gnas su gyi na'i zas gos kyis/ /yun ring 'tsho ba'i dka' thub byed pa ni/ /da lta'i skye bos nus pa ma lags pas/ /mi tshe dkor la 'byam pa'i bla ma dang / /skyong byed tshul du bzhugs pa'i ban chung gi /rnam thar bor nas mtha' gnyis spangs pa yi/ /thabs mkhas spyod pas sku tshe don yod mdzod/ /gnas skabs lhan du skyes pa'i gnyen rnams la/ /ha cang brtse ba'i phreng thag dam pa na/ /rnam dag dam chos sgrub pa'i gegs yin zhes/ /chos bzhin mdzad pa'i dam pa snga mas gsungs/ /rang la gnod cing gzhan la mi phan pas/ /da lta gnyen rnams skyong ba'i dus ma lags/ /skyid sdug sna tshogs sngon las btsan pos byas/ /'di la gzhan gyis bcos su ji ltar yod/ /de bas tshe rabs gzhan du 'di dag la/ /dge ba'i bshes kyis bgyi ba gang yin pa/ /de kun bdag gis byed par shog cig ces/ /rjes brtse smon pa'i yul las ma dor na/ /gnyen la phan zhing rang yang mi 'ching bas/ /ma smad don gnyis sgrub pa'i thabs mkhas 'di/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras snga ma'i rnam thar te/ /rjes 'jug skye bo'i nyams len lags sam snyam/ /des na re zhig gnyen rnams ring spangs nas/ /dben pa'i gnas su sgrub la gzhol gyur na/ /'di snang grogs kyi ngo 'dzum ma mthong yang / /thub pa'i zhal bzang blta la mi ring nye/ /gal te rnyed dang bkur sti la sogs pa/ /srid pa'i phun tshogs dang du blangs gyur na/ /zhi ba'i yon tan thob par mi 'gyur bas/ /'khor ba'i bde la nam yang chags mi bya/ /re zhig sgrub la brtson par 'gyur na yang / /gzhan don ltar snang sgrub pa'i bslu brid kyis/ /chos brgyad 'du 'dzi'i g.yang la lhung gyur na/ /sgrub 'bras tshe 'di'i phyogs su shor ba'i phyir/ /chos de chos dang mthun pa ma yin zhes/ /chos 'dod skyes bu chos la bskul ba'i phyir/ /chos spyan ldan pa'i chos rje snga ma yi/

/chos tshul ston pa'i chos gtam rnams nas 'byung / /mdor na ha cang g.yeng chen ma lags par/ /lkog tu rang rgyud chos kyis 'dul ba ni/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir gnad du che ba'i phyir/ /sbas pa'i tshul gyis sgrub la brtson par mdzod/ /rang la nyams len rdul tsam med bzhin du/ /gzhan la gdams pa 'chad pa khrel ba'i rgyur/ /song yang snying dang 'dra ba'i grogs po mchog /khyed kyi bka' gsung gcog par ma nus lags/ /rnam dpyod blo gros gsal ba'i mched khyod la/ /rnam dag bslab bya 'doms pa'i tshig gi phreng / /rnam dag lhag bsam gtsang mas sbyar ba las/ /rnam mang dge ba bdag gis gang thob des/ /yid mthun chos kyis 'brel ba bdag cag gnyis/ /tshes rabs kun tu rgyal ba'i ring lugs la/ /lta spyod mthun zhing chos mthun grogs gyur te/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen 'grub par shog /gdams pa 'di gsum ni bla ma blo gros kyi bzhed skong du sprul sku a 'jam pas bris pa lags so// //dge'o// ༈ /oṃ swasti/ yun ring snying la nyal ba'i nang gi mun/ /gang gi thugs rje'i zer gyis 'joms mdzad pa/ /ngag gi dbang phyug lhag pa'i lha mchog dang / /dbyer med drin chen bla mas bdag skyongs shig /sngon bsags bsod nams chu gter las 'ongs shing / /skyes sbyangs blo gros cha shas yongs su rdzogs/ /legs bshad 'od dkar dra bas nyer mdzes pa'i/ /grogs mchog smra ba'i zla bar 'di skad zhu/ /spyod ngan mi sdug mtshan mas brgyan pa'i lus/ /rnam gsum bslab pa'i gos kyis ma bsgribs par/ /rnam g.yeng dga' ma'i phyi bzhin rgyug pa yi/ /phongs pa bdag la gdams pa'i nor med mod/ /'on kyang ring nas mthun par 'grogs pa'i grogs/ /khyed kyis yang yang bskul ba ma bzod nas/ /rjes brtse'i chu las skyes pa'i legs bshad kyi/ /me tog phreng ba 'di ni khyod la sbyin/ /khams gsum sems can yang yang za ba yi/ /mi rtag srin mo'i so bar tshang bcas nas/

/bdag nyid gnas pa'i ngang tshul 'di mthong tshe/ /yid ni bde ba'i go skabs bral bar gyur/ /khyed kyang 'di 'dra'i tshul la dgongs nas ni/ /ha cang ngang sring sos dal mi mdzad par/ /myur du 'gro ba'i mgron po ji bzhin du/ /phyi ma'i lam rgyags tshags su tshud par mdzod/ /'phral snang nyams dga' srid pa'i phun tshogs 'di/ /'dzum gyis bslu ba srin mo'i ngang tshul bzhin/ /su zhig chags kyang phung bar 'gyur bas na/ /'di la khyed kyis dug bzhin 'dzem par mdzod/ /rnyed bkur lus phra'i zur mig sbyin pa'i tshe/ /kun rtog gzhon nu dran pas ma zin par/ /sred pa'i 'dren byed gang la g.yos gyur na/ /rnam grol bde ba'i ngal gso thob par dka'/ /dang por bslab gsum nor gyis phyug na yang / /nyon mongs chom rkun rgyu 'grul ma bcad pas/ /grogs po phal cher sprang por mthong nas ni/ /khyed kyis dran shes mel tshe yang yang mdzod/ /lha dang bla mar gsol ba btab nas ni/ /yid ches gdeng drod khong nas shar ba 'am/ /sgrin po'i blo yis brtag dpyad ma mdzad par/ /bya ba gang la'ang gya tshom 'jug mi rung / /gnas skabs rgyus med lam du 'gro ba la/ /yid ches grogs shig nges par bsten dgos na/ /rgyus med phyi ma'i lam chen len pa la/ /dam pa'i grogs shig cis kyang med thabs med/ /de slad bla ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas las/ /dbang lung khrid gsum legs par thob pa yi/ /yi dam lha la khyed shes blo gtad kyis/ /mgon skyabs bya la phyi bshol byar mi rung / /bla ma mchog gi thugs mdzod las 'ong ba'i/ /gdams pa'i bdud rtsi phyag tu thogs nas ni/ /'di snang byis pa'i rtse grogs mdzad gyur na/ /sus kyang ma spyad gar song med par 'gyur/ /mkhyen brtse'i 'od stong 'bar ba'i mkhas grub kyi/ /nyin byed snang ba nub pa'i mtshan dus su/ /yon tan cha rdzogs bla ma'i zla gzhon 'di/ /bdag cag rnams kyis skal pa'i dbang las rnyed/

/tshul 'di shes nas bla ma rin po che/ /mos gus dad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod nas/ /kha zhe med pa'i khyed shes blo gtad kyis/ /gsol ba 'debs pa lam gyi rtsa ba yin/ /rnal 'byor ngas kyang nyams len 'di la bgyis/ /grogs po khyod kyis thugs dam de la mdzod/ /'dod 'byung nor bu 'di 'dra thob nas ni/ /rgud pa mtha' dag bros pa bzhin du 'gyur/ /rtog dpyod phyi la shor ba'i blo mig gis/ /gzhan la sgro skur gleng mos dus 'da' zhing / /rang gi gnas tshul nam yang mi mthong bas/ /thos pa'i chos rnams rang gi rgyud la sbyor/ /chos dang gang zag bzang ngan 'byed pa'i blo/ /rang gi 'khrul rtog yin par ma shes na/ /kun la dag pa'i snang ba mi skye bas/ /dang por rang sems gtan la 'bebs pa gces/ /'du 'dzi nyin mo'i snang ba dang 'grogs nas/ /rang sems rtog tshogs rgyu skar mi mthong bas/ /dben gsum zla ba'i 'od dkar bsten bzhin du/ /gang thugs lhod kyis bzhag na mngon par 'gyur/ /de nas brgyud ldan bla ma'i man ngag bzhin/ /gsal stong zung 'jug sems kyi snang ba dang / /gnas tshul ji bzhin 'byed pa'i man ngag gi /nyams len zab mo srang du tshud par mdzod/ /dge sbyor srang du ma tshud 'o zob 'dis/ /ltar snang gzhan dag mgu ba srid na yang / /rgyu des dad zas bu lon 'phel ba las/ /phyi ma'i lam sna zin pa'i nges pa med/ /yid kyi sa gzhir mos pa'i sa bon btab/ /thabs mkhas zhing pas brtson pas srung ba dang / /bla ma'i thugs rje'i char gyis legs bskyangs na/ /phan bde'i lo tog de nas 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mkhas 'dod ltad mo'i tshul gyis rang gzhan gyi/ /grub mtha' rgya mtsho mthong ba'i blo mig las/ /spyod 'dod gus pa'i sems kyis gdams pa'i bcud/ /cung zad myang ba skal pa bzang ngam snyam/ /bstan bcos thos pa'i chang gis cher myos nas/ /sgro skur tshig gi 'chal gtam sgrog bzhin du/ /rang rgyud yang dag lam las 'dred gyur na/

/las ngan khur chen gsog par mi 'gyur ram/ /thub pa'i legs gsung sde snod rnam pa gsum/ /rang rgyud 'dul ba'i thabs su gsungs pas na/ /tshig gcig thos kyang 'di yis bdag gi sems/ /ji ltar 'dul snyam bsam pas gtan la dbab/ /de don yang yang sems pa bsgom pa ste/ /nges 'byung byams brtse byang chub sems kyi nor/ /de 'dra'i tshul gyis yang yang bsgrubs nas ni/ /dri med thugs mdzod chos kyis gang bar byos/ /mkhyen rab lang tsho mdzes pa'i gzhon nu la/ /nyams len sgrub pa'i mdza' gcugs lha'i bu mo/ /sbas don rim gnyis rgyan gyis bklubs pa zhig /grogs su 'os kyi gzhan gyis ci zhig bya/ /thos pa'i mig nyams blo gros lus stobs shor/ /nges 'byung byams brtse'i nor gyis dbul bzhin du/ /sgrub pa'i dga' ma 'bod pa 'ga' mthong na/ /grogs mchog khyed kyis zhum pa bsten mi rung / /dben gnas lha yi dga' tshal der song nas/ /bsam gtan bdud rtsi'i zas kyis 'tsho bzhin du/ /nyams rtogs rtse dga'i bde ba myong ba la/ /rgan po bdag kyang da dung re ba lags/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i shul lam 'dir zhugs tshe/ /bar chad nyi rdul las kyang ches mang bas/ /thams cad gnyen pos gzhom gyis mi lang gi /rkyen ngan lam khyer gdams pa'i snying por mdzod/ /gang du gnas kyang bde ba'i go skabs med/ /su dang 'grogs kyang blo gtad yid ches dka'/ /ji tsam 'byor yang sems la khengs dus med/ /da ni blo sna 'phral chod mdzad na legs/ /dga' dga' lta bu'i 'dzum gyis reng sems bslu/ /'grub 'grub 'dra ba'i re bas thams cad phung / /skyid skyid lta bu'i spyod pas chags sdang 'phel/ /bden bden 'dra ba'i snang ba thams cad brdzun/ /'du 'dzi spong ba chos pa'i sta gon yin/ /dben ri 'dzin pa gong ma'i gdan sa yin/ /sdug bsngal dang len rgyal sras lag len yin/ /rang sems 'dul ba dam pa'i rnam thar lags/

/dang po rang sems chos dang ma 'dres par/ /chos pa'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don spyod pa/ /nga dang nga 'dra'i 'chad po'i gzugs brnyan gyi/ /dge ba'i bshes la byang chub thag re ring / /bdag 'dzin nyon mongs nad kyis gdung bzhin du/ /dam chos sman mchog rang gis mi myong bar/ /gdams pa rgya mtsho'i sman gyis gzhan gyi nad/ /gso bar rloms pa bdag 'dra gad mo'i gnas/ /nyams len zas la yi ga ma phye bas/ /bslab gsum lto ba bkres pas gdung bzhin du/ /mgrin pa'i lam nas legs bshad bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /skyug pa 'di yang tshul dang mthun pa min/ /dam pa'i skye srid chen po'i rgyal tshab tu/ /khas 'che 'gro ba'i 'dren par chas pa yi/ /bla ma'i khur gyis dub pa mang mod kyang / /rang sems chos dang mthun pa nyung bar snang / /rang mgo thon pa'i nyams len med bzhin du/ /gzhan don sgrub pa'i bya bas dus 'da' ba'i/ /bstan 'dzin de 'dra deng sang mang na yang / /bstan dang 'gro la phan pa ci 'dug sems/ /rang la blo ldog rnam bzhi'i grub mtha' tsam/ /med bzhin khyed dang nged kyi grub mtha' zhes/ /chags sdang snyems pa mtho ba'i kha 'ur 'dis/ /yang dag grub mtha' rmangs nas 'jig par byed/ /nges 'byung byang chub sems kyi grub pa'i mtha'/ /skal bzang gang gis rnyed pa de dag gis/ /grub mtha' thams cad 'gal med mthong nas ni/ /chags sdang grub mtha'i sgrog las grol bar 'gyur/ /de slad rnam dpyod nyi 'od ltar gsal ba'i/ /grogs dag legs nyes 'dam ka ma nor bar/ /man ngag gnad kyis zin pa'i dam chos shig /sgrub pa'i dus la bab pa ma lags sam/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin rtogs 'dod na/ /shing rta chen po klu sgrub yab sras dang / /bdag nyid chen po 'jam dbyangs bla ma sogs/ /'khrul med gzhung la brten nas yid ches bskyed/ /de las gzhan du mkhas mang bstan bcos kyi/ /zer sgros sna tshogs gcig tu bsdus gyur na/

/'gal 'du'i dbang gis sgro skur rtog pa skye/ /phyogs lhung dbang gis yang dag don mi rtogs/ /lta ba'i snyigs ma shin tu bdo ba'i phyir/ /yang dag lam bzang rnyed par dka' bas na/ /rton pa bzhi po phyin ci ma log par/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam la gus par mdzod/ /rgyal bas lung bstan 'phags pa klu sgrub dang / /grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan bir+wa pa/ /rnam pa gnyis las rim par brgyud pa yi/ /mdo sngags gnyis kyi lta sgom dpyod pa'i gnad/ /tshang la ma nor gcig tu bsdus pa ni/ /rnal 'byor dbang po brtse chen sa skya pa/ /brgyud par bcas pas rim par bskyangs pa yi/ /rang lugs yid bzhin nor bu 'di yin no/ /gang de mkhyen pa'i rgya mtshor gnas bcas pa'i/ /bla ma'i ded dpon gus pas bsten pa dang / /rang gi las 'phro mos gus brtson 'grus kyis/ /da lta bdag blo mdzod kyi nor du gyur/ /gshis ngan dud 'gro'i ngang tshul 'dzin lags mod/ /zab don snyan brgyud legs bshad ma gi ta/ /blo gros lte ba'i dpal du bzung ba 'di/ /don gnyer skye bos blang 'os yin na yang / /dus kyi dbang gis sus kyang mi myong bas/ /re zhig gzhan la ster ba'i blo med kyang / /chos 'di'i brgyud pa zin du re nas ni/ /sbyin par 'gyur gyi grogs dag dga' bas longs/ /'di don tshul bzhin sgom pa'i nyams rtogs ni/ /bdag gi rgyud la nges par ma mchis kyang / /nyams su len pa'i tshul la ma rmongs pa'i/ /blo 'di lha dang bla ma'i drin gyis yin/ /nyams myong med pa'i kha chos bshad pa 'dis/ /gzhan la mi phan rang la gnod pas na/ /dbul po'i nor bu gzhan la ster ba bzhin/ /phangs kyang rang dbang rang gis 'dzin ma nus/ /dang po dge ba'i bshes las thos pa btsal/ /bar du thos don bsam pas gtan la phab/ /da lta rang sems steng du mdo rgyud kyi/ /zab gnad bsdu ba brtson pa'i lag rjes yin/ /skyes dang sbyangs pa'i blo gros mthu chung yang /

/sangs rgyas dngos 'dra'i bla ma rnyed pa'i tshe/ /mos gus gsol 'debs thang lhod ma byas pas/ /mi 'phrog yid ches snying gi khong nas shar/ /de slad grogs dag mnyam 'grogs mi byed par/ /rgan po'i tshig la yid ches bskyed nas ni/ /zab mo'i chos dang rang sems 'dres pa zhig /byung na de bas lhag pa'i zhu don med/ /kye ma rgyal bstan nyi ma nub rir 'dzegs/ /mi bsrun skye bos phyogs kun rab bzung ba'i/ /lnga brgya tha ma'i dus kyi rgud pa rnams/ /dran bzhin rang gis rang nyid 'chos par mdzod/ /gzhung brgya 'chad pa'i khur gyis brel bzhin du/ /rang sems tha mal lus pa'i 'chad pa po/ /'chi tshe dud 'gro'i rnam thar 'dzin pa la/ /yid smon ma byed de la khrel gyis thob/ /bde skyid 'dod kyang skyid dus da ni med/ /mthun 'jug mkhas kyang thams cad mgu ba dka'/ /sgrub kyang las la grub dus mi 'ong ba'i/ /ngang tshul shes nas tshe 'di'i bya ba bor/ /sngon spyad las la snying po ngas ma mthong / /da lta'i 'khrul snang de bas ya re nga / /slan chad dgung nyi tsam gyi tshe mjug 'dir/ /chags sdang bzlog phyir cis kyang 'bad par zhu/ /phyi nang snod bcud gang la bsam yang rung / /yid skyo 'phel ba'i rgyu las ma mchis pas/ /dben pa'i ri la sgrub tshugs zin pa dang / /snying po'i btsan sa myur du zin par mdzod/ /dang por dge ba thos bsam khyed kyis mdzad/ /bar du dge ba sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ /tha mar dge ba 'phrin las bzang po yis/ /bstan 'gror phan pa'i smon 'dun nged kyis zhu/ /chos dang rang sems nang nas 'dres pa dang / /tshe dang dam pa'i chos spyod snyoms pa dang / /rnam dkar phrin las 'gro ba'i don byed cing / /sku tshe zhabs pad yun du brtan par shog /lha dang bla ma'i byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs/ /dam can srung ma lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs/ /bshad dang sgrub pas nyin mtshan dus 'da' bas/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i phrin las spel gyur cig

/gang zhig khyed la gsol ba'i don de kun/ /ji bzhin thugs kyi ze'u 'brur 'ching mdzod dang / /don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal ldan pa'i/ /chos kyi rgyal srid khyed kyis zin par 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di ni dpral ba'i mig ltar gces pa kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i bzhed skong du kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis bris pa'o// ༈ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byin rlabs zla shel 'dzum pa'i bsil zer gyis/ /blo gros kun+da'i tshal rab rgyas byed pa/ /ngag gi dbang phyug lhag pa'i lha mchog dang / /dbyer med drin chen bla mas bdag skyongs shig /lhag bsam chu yi rlan gyis skyed bsrings shing / /bla ma'i zhal lung nyi zer gyis bran pa'i/ /yid 'ong gdams pa'i me tog phreng mdzes 'di/ /bu mchog khyod kyi rna ba'i rgyan du longs/ /dal 'byor rten thob mtshan ldan bla ma mjal/ /skyes sbyang blo gros mtshungs pa ma mchis pa/ /grogs khyod skal pa shin tu bzang lags pas/ /da ni snying po'i btsan sa 'dzin re ran/ /spyir ni 'dus byas chos la yid brtan med/ /khyad par snyigs ma'i gnas grogs longs spyod la/ /ci ltar bsams kyang snying po mi 'dug pas/ /zhen pa spong bar mdzod cig snying gi bu/ /lhag bsam byang chub sems kyis ma zin pa'i/ /bdag dang bdag 'dra'i bla gzugs phal mo ches/ /ltar snang gzhan don sgrub pa'i rnam g.yeng 'dis/ /rang gzhan phung la sbyar ba gzigs lags sam/ /nam zhig 'chi ba cis kyang 'byung mod kyang / /re zhig mi skyon snyam pa'i ngang ring 'dis/ /bdag gi 'di phyi'i mdo don kun gtor bas/ /rgyun du blo sna bstung bar mdzod cig bu/ /sna tshogs rkyen mang gzhan dbang rten 'brel gyis/ /bsam don thog tu khel ba dka' bas na/ /lha dang bla mar yid ches blo gtad kyis/ /gang byung lam du 'khyer ba gnad du che/ /'dzin stangs yul gyi steng du shor ba na/ /kun la dag pa'i snang ba mi skye bas/

/sgro skur rtog pa'i rang mtshang rig nas ni/ /kun la dag pa'i snang bas khyab par mdzod/ /thos bsam bshad sgrub gang la zhugs na yang / /chos brgyad blo ngan gdon gyis ma bslad par/ /'phral dang phug gi khe nyen mthong nas ni/ /brtags shing dpyad nas 'jug pa mkhas pa'i lugs/ /sgrub la brtson pa'i gnas skabs thams cad du/ /re dogs rtog pa'i dbang du mi 'chor bar/ /mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di nyid kyis/ /gegs sel bogs 'don mtha' dag 'grub par gsungs/ /dgung nyi tsam gyi tshe mjug 'di nyid la/ /blo sna mang na thams cad 'grub dka' bas/ /yi dam gcig la khyed shes blo gtad kyis/ /nyams len snying por dril ba gnad du shes/ /sngags kyi khyad chos dbang gi ye shes mchog /rnal 'byor thun bzhis nyams su len pa'i tshul/ /brgyud pa mchog 'di'i bka' srol las 'ong ba'i/ /thugs dam 'di la gcig tu gus par mdzod/ /rgyud kyi mdor bstan gleng gzhi'i rnam dag gis/ /gdul bya'i lam rim ston par gsungs pa ltar/ /rgyas gdab lnga yis yongs su bsdus pa'i don/ /bsre ba gsum gyis nyams su len pa'i tshul/ /dag pa gnyis ldan 'bras bu'i yon tan rnams/ /gzhi dang mtshungs pa'i rnam pa lam byed kyis/ /'khor 'das bsres nas lam byed bzhi ldan du/ /bsgoms nas tha mal snang zhen spong la brtson/ /phung po dug lnga rten dang bcas pa la/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i tshul/ /dag snang ye shes chen pos rgyas 'debs pa/ /gya nom lhar zhen 'jig pa'i gdams ngag yin/ /man ngag gnad kyis zin pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /phyi nang bdud dang sgrib gsum mun pa'i tshogs/ /skad cig nyid la dbyings su gcod pa yi/ /zab chos 'di 'dra gzhan gyi lugs na med/ /skye gnas bzhi dang rtsa rlung thig le sogs/ /ye shes gcig gi ngo bor ngo sprad nas/ /stong bzhi'i 'od gsal zung 'jug dang bcas pa/ /mngon byang lnga yis nyams su len pa yin/

/chos kun bden med sgyu mar shes pa'i blos/ /dus gsum dus med rtogs nas gnyis chos kun/ /gnyis med bde ba chen por ro snyoms pa/ /lam bzang 'di yi gnad don mchog gcig lags/ /'khrul snang las nyon tshogs su bsgyur ba sogs/ /mig 'phrul lta bu'i ting 'dzin la gnas nas/ /'ja' lus sgyu ma'i sku mchog bsgrub pa dang / /skye med chos sku'i btsan sa zin par mdzod/ /re dogs nang gi bdud chen g.yos pa las/ /rang snang phyi ru bzung ba'i gdon bgegs rnams/ /rang sems nyid las gzhan du ma grub pa'i/ /ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du glod na bde/ /dug gsum yan par shor ba'i dregs pa'i tshogs/ /rang sems rig pa'i rtsal las ma 'das pas/ /rig stong chos sku'i rang zhal mjal ba na/ /dag pa rab 'byams 'bad nas tshol mi dgos/ /gzhi snang rgyud gsum dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /zab lam bsre ba gsum gyi man ngag gis/ /sku gsum 'bras bu'i ngo bo khyer shes pa/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mthar thug yin/ /sna tshogs chos rnams sems las byung ba'i phyir/ /rang sems chos kyis thul ba'i skad cig la/ /phyi yi chos kun dbang du 'du ba yi/ /nang gi rten 'brel gnad la mkhas par mdzod/ /nga rgyal spangs te mchog dman bar ma'i 'gro/ /kun la ma gus brnyas pa'i sems spong ba/ /snga rabs gshegs pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /bgrod pa'i lam bzang yin pa los kyang dgongs/ /gzhan phan sems la goms 'dris brtan pa na/ /gzhan don phrin las 'bad med 'byung ngo zhes/ /bdag gi 'dren mchog dge ba'i bshes rnams kyis/ /brtse bas bdag la yang yang gdams par mdzad/ /chos ldan skyes bu yun ring 'tsho ba ni/ /phun tshogs dge legs rgya mtsho'i gzhi yin pas/ /bla ma'i lung dang bdag gi ngag bzhin du/ /sku tshe bsring ba'i thabs la 'bad par mdzod/ /rnam dag lhag bsam ldan pa'i skyes bu la/ /nag phyogs 'byung pos 'tshe ba chos nyid yin/

/de slad thabs mkhas rten 'brel sna tshogs kyis/ /'khrul snang bdud sde chos kyi dbyings su skyol/ /bar chad log sgrub ci 'dra byung na yang / /thams cad gnyen pos gzhom gyis mi lang gi /rkyen ngan lam khyer gnad la goms gyur na/ /nam yang bslu ba med pa'i grogs po yin/ /'dus byas chos rnams skad cig skad cig ste/ /ched 'dzin bya rin chog pa mi 'ong bas/ /gang la'ang snying po med pa'i tshul shes na/ /'gyod pa'i zug rngu ldang ba mi srid do/ /mdor na 'jam mgon bla ma chos kyi rje/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas des/ /bdag cag rjes 'jug bu la gnang ba yi/ /zab gsang dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi rnams/ /dad brtson blo yi snyim pas legs gsol nas/ /rnam g.yeng phyir bshol dbang du mi gtong bar/ /chos dang rang sems nang nas 'dres pa dang / /nyams rtogs yon tan lus stobs bskyed par mdzod/ /grogs khyod 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po yi/ /thugs brtses rjes su bzung ba'i sras yin pas/ /bla ma'i rnam thar yid la bcangs nas ni/ /sgrub pa'i dam bca' zungs shig snying gi bu/ /khyod kyi sku tshe yun du brtan pa dang / /thugs kyi bzhed don lhun gyis grub nas ni/ /rnam dkar phrin las 'gro la phan 'dogs pa'i/ /smon 'dun sprang po ngas kyang yang yang zhu/ /lha dang bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i chos la dbang 'byor nas/ /rang dang gzhan gyi don gnyis mthar phyin te/ /bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon mdzad pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di ni mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug sde snod 'dzin pa chen po phrin las chos 'phel gyi bzhed skong du chos smra ba'i btsun pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis bris pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ ༄/ /bla ma'i zhabs la gus pas phyag byas nas/ /khyod la brtse bas mchid 'di bdag gis bri/ /mi lus 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'/

/mi rtag 'chi ba nam 'ong nges pa med/ /mtshan ldan bla ma mjal ba da res tsam/ /da res myur du chos la ma 'bad na/ /phyi nas 'di 'dra'i skal bzang rnyed dka' bas/ /gcig tu brtson pas mi tshe don yod gyis/ /yid ches blo gtad nam yang mi 'gyur bas/ /mchog gsum bla ma spyi bo'i thod bzhin bkur/ /gegs dang gol sa bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /che 'brel chung 'brel gcig tu tshang ba'i chos/ /nyams len snying po rin chen byang chub sems/ /'di dang rang sems 'dres pa'i skal bzang zhig /byung na de bas lhag pa'i chos mi dgos/ /za nyal 'gro 'dug bya ba ji byed kyang / /mdor na dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du/ /bsam pa bzang po 'di dang ma bral na/ /rgyal ba'i lamalas gzhan du 'phyugs pa med/ /'du 'bral med pa'i mos gus gdung shugs kyis/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar rgyun du gsol ba thob/ /las 'bras bslu med dpang por btsugs nas ni/ /srog gi phyir yang sdig pa'i bya ba spong / /'chi tshe rang la 'gyod pa mi 'byung tsam/ /byung na dal 'byor don yod bya ba lags/ /lha dang bla ma mchog gi byin rlabs dang / /bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /smras pa'i tshig 'di grogs po khyod nyid kyi/ /rgyud la 'byor nas bsam pa 'grub par shog /ces phur rtsa tshul khrims la gdams pa dge'o// ༄/ /zhal gdams yid kyi pad+mo'i kha 'byed 'od stong bdag po bzhugs/ rang don spangs rtogs yon tan yongs su rdzogs/ /gzhan don gdul bya'i re 'dod yid bzhin skong / /mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ /nyung ngu'i tshig 'di gus pa'i yid kyis spel/ /dang po chos lam gnyer ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /'khor ba'i gnas ris gang du skyes gyur kyang / /bde ba'i go skabs nam yang med pa'i tshul/ /yid ches nges pa gting nas ma rnyed na/ /tshe 'di'i phun tshogs 'dod pa'i blo ngan dang / /'grogs pa'i thos bsam bsgom pa'i bya ba yis/

/thar pa'i lam bzang bgrod par mi nus pas/ /tshe 'di'i zhen pa dug bzhin spong bar mdzod/ /chos la zhugs tshe gnyen grogs mdza' bshes kyis/ /log pa'i lam du bsgyur bar gsungs pas na/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' lung ji bzhin du/ /blo thag bcad nas rang tshugs 'dzin pa gces/ /dben pa'i gnas su sgrub la gzhol ba'i dus/ /tshul min yid byed rtog pa'i bdud las 'dis/ /phyin ci log gi g.yang sar 'khrid pas na/ /dran shes bzang pos rang sems 'dul ba gnad/ /yon tan cung zad rgyud la skyes pa'i tshe/ /ltar snang gzhan don byed pa'i rnam g.yeng gis/ /sgrub 'bras tshe 'dir 'chor bar gsungs pas na/ /chos brgyad blo ngan lam kha'i ro bzhin spongs/ /rang gi nyams su blang bya'i chos de yi/ /thog mtha' kun la mkhas par ma sbyangs na/ /ne tso'i kha 'don lta bu'i nyams len la/ /brtson pa mang yang lam sna zin pa nyung / /skyid 'dod tshe 'di'i zhen pa spangs nas ni/ /nges 'byung byang chub sems kyis zin pa yis/ /sdug bsngal dang len dka' spyad drag po yis/ /sgrub la brtson pa dam pa'i rnam thar lags/ /bdag 'dzin 'gong po'i gnyen por ma song ba'i/ /ltar snang chos kyis chos go mi chod pas/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug byang chub sems mchog gis/ /rang sems 'dul ba rgyal ba'i sras kyi tshul/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems mchog gis/ /rang gi sems 'di 'dul bar ma nus na/ /legs smon dug gis sbags pa'i bsnyen sgrub des/ /rnam mkhyen lam du 'gro bar dka' ba lags/ /'du 'dzi spel ba'i grogs ngan ma spangs na/ /yengs ma lam du mi tshe zad 'gyur bas/ /smra ba bcad nas dben pa'i ri khrod du/ /sgrub la brtson na mi tshe don yod yin/ /'dir snang che rgu'i zhal 'dzum ma mthong zhing / /dpal 'byor longs spyod gang yang ma mchis kyang / /dman sa bzung nas sgrub la gzhol nus na/ /mtshungs med bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs par nges/

/ldan dang grol ba'i yon tan med bzhin du/ /dad rdzas zos pa'i nyes pa lci ba'i phyir/ /kha mgo thon tsam zas gos 'byor ba'i tshe/ /rang tshod bzung nas rang sems chos dang bsres/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed rang ngo ma 'phrod pa'i/ /bskyed rdzogs sgom pas 'khrul snang 'jig dka' bas/ /'jam mgon brgyud pa'i bka' srol ji bzhin du/ /'khor 'das bsre ba'i gnad la mkhas par mdzod/ /nyams len man ngag gnad kyis ma zin pa'i/ /chos gzugs tsam gyis 'chi khar mi phan pas/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i bka' lung ji bzhin du/ /zab mo'i nyams len srang du tshud dgos shing / /byin rlabs brgyud pa'i bka' bab ma nyams pa'i/ /bla ma 'di 'dra deng sang rnyed dka' bas/ /kha zhe med par dad pa'i gdung shugs kyis/ /gsol ba 'debs pa lam gyi rtsa ba yin/ /rang rgyud g.yo sgyu'i skyon gyis ma bslad cing / /mchog dman kun la zhe 'gras ma shor bar/ /dben pa'i gnas su 'chi ba sgug nus na/ /bdag ni snying nas de la spro bar 'dug /brgyud pa mchog 'di'i bka' srol las byung ba'i/ /snyan brgyud bzhi ldan dbang bzhi'i lam bzang po/ /chag med tshul gyis nyams su len nus na/ /dal 'byor rin chen rnyed pa don bcas yin/ /yang gsang mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs ma yal ba'i/ /snyan brgyud zab mo rang la yod bzhin du/ /ri bong cal bzhin 'ud can gzhan dag gi /rjes su 'brang ba chos skal chad pa'i rtags/ /dal 'byor thob cing mtshan ldan bla ma mjal/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen tshang dus 'dir/ /blo sna bstungs nas rtse gcig sgrub pa la/ /gzhol ba'i dam bca' snying gi dkyil nas mdzod/ /rang gi sems rgyud chos dang ma 'dres pa'i/ /rmongs pa bdag las gdams ngag mi 'byung mod/ /chos mthun grogs kyi zhal ngo ma chog nas/ /yid la gang dran yi ge'i lam du spel/ /chos dang 'brel ba'i bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /tshe rabs kun tu 'jam mgon bla ma yi/

/zhabs pad brtan cing lta spyod mthun pa dang / /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen byed par shog /ces pa 'di ni thar lam dbu mdzad 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dang / don gling tshe mtshams pa bsam gtan phrin las gnyis kyi bzhed skong du yul li thang phyogs su skyes pa'i ban de kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis bris pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ ༄/ /'pho med chos sku'i dgongs pa mngon gyur kyang / /bzod med duḥkhas mnar ba'i 'gro ba la/ /thugs rje'i spyan ras zum par mi mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi drin gyis lhan skyes bde ba che/ /bde blag nyid du rtogs pa'i thabs kyi mchog /zab mo'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ /gsang chen lam gyi snying po'i dam pa lags/ /de yang rang gi phung khams skye mched la/ /rnam dag gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogs kyi/ /sa bon btab nas byin gyis rlob mdzad pa/ /rigs kun khyab bdag rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus par thag bcad nas/ /nyin mo spyi bor mtshan mo snying dbus su/ /yang yang bsgoms nas gsol ba snying nas 'debs/ /spangs rtogs mthar phyin bla ma'i gsang gsum dang / /tha mal rang gi sgo gsum bsres nas ni/ /the tshom med par da lta'i rig pa 'di/ /ma yengs ma bcos 'dzin med lhug par zhog /blo 'das 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po yi/ /gnas lugs don gyi bla ma'i rang zhal lta/ /rjes thob snang grags rig pa'i chos rnams kun/ /bla ma'i rdo rje gsum du shes pa'i blos/ /yid ches bskyed la gsol ba btab pa'i mthar/ /snang sems bsres la 'dzin med lta ba skyongs/ /rgyal kun yum gyur rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /rang ngor bla ma'i tshul du snang ba'i phyir/ /lha dang bla ma ngo bo dbyer med du/ /nges pa'i shes pa gting nas skyes pa na/ /bla ma mjal yang de yis mi tshim par/ /yi dam gzhan du tshol ba'i blo ngan 'jig /snang srid 'khor 'das bsdus pa'i chos rnams kun/

/rang sems rig pa'i rtsal du shes pa na/ /gnyug ma 'od gsal don gyi bla ma las/ /gzhan pa'i skyabs gnas med pa'i phu thag chod/ /mnyam bzhag dmigs med lta ba bsgom pa dang / /rjes thob snang ba sgyu ma'i tshul du shes/ /rlabs chen rgya chen spyod pa'i gzhung bsrangs te/ /nam zhig mnyam rjes res 'jog ma yin par/ /dmigs med ngang du ro mnyam gyur pa na/ /mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i tha snyad byed/ /dang por chos kyi lam du 'jug pa na/ /srid las nges par 'byung ba'i blo bskyed nas/ /dgag sgrub gnang ba'i spyod pa ma lus pa/ /mig 'bras bzhin du srung sdom bgyi la 'bad/ /bar du rim gnyis sgom pa brtan pa na/ /a 'thas gu dog spyod pa spangs nas ni/ /lam kun gzings bzhin 'dor bar byed pa ni/ /lam mthar phyin pa snga ma'i rnam thar lags/ /chos brgyad rtog pa 'jig pa'i lta ba dang / /las 'bras dpang du btsugs pa'i spyod pa gnyis/ /thabs la mkhas pas zung du ma chud na/ /bden gnyis ya bral gyur pa'i nyes pa yod/ /re dogs dgag sgrub rtog pa'i phreng ba rnams/ /mnyam nyid rtogs pa'i rgyan du khyer nas ni/ /srid zhi gnyis med zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang / /tshe 'di nyid la mngon du 'gyur bar mdzod/ /'di dag rang gi rgyud na ma mchis pas/ /go yul tshig gi phreng ba spel ba la/ /sems ni shin tu skrag par gyur na yang / /sgrub brtson bla ma dam pa khyod nyid kyi/ /gsung gis bskul ba ldog tu ma phod nas/ /shākya'i dge slong kun dga'i ming gis bris/ /nongs pa lha dang bla ma'i spyan sngar 'chag /dge bas khyed kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / /slad mar rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyu ru bsngo// ༄/ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdom gsum nyes pa'i dri mas dben zhing / /theg gsum lam gyi yon tan kun rdzogs/ /gsang gsum rgyal ba'i ngo bor bzhugs pa'i/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus bla ma mkhyen no/ /chos kun sgrib med mngon sum gzigs shing /

/'gro ba yongs la bu ltar brtse ba/ /rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las rang gzugs/ /dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /snying nas chos lam gnyer ba'i 'dun ma/ /lhag bsam ri mo sems la bris kyang / /bsam don thog tu khel ba dka' bas/ /bar chad bdud las rgyal bar mdzod cig /thugs brtse'i thugs kyis yun ring bskyangs pa'i/ /snying gi grogs mchog dam pa khyod la/ /bcos ma spangs pa'i bden pa'i tshig gis/ /mchid 'di gsol gyis thugs la zhog mdzod/ /rnyed dka'i mi lus rin chen 'di 'dra/ /slan chad thob par dka' ba lags pas/ /rnam dkar lha chos sgrub pa'i 'dun pa/ /thugs kyi dkyil nas bor du mi rung / /nam 'chi nges pa su la'ang med pas/ /glo bur 'chi bdag gshin rje sleb kyang / /'gyod pa med pa'i dge tshogs ci 'grub/ /da lta nyid nas tshags su tshud dgos/ /chos dang 'jig rten bya ba gang la/ /blo rtse dkon mchog gsum la gtad nas/ /yid ches mchog gsum yul la byed pa/ /dam pa snga ma'i rnam thar lags pas/ /skyid sdug legs nyes ci 'dra byung yang / /las 'bras bslu med sems la bzung ste/ /mchog gsum bla mar gsol ba btab na/ /bsam don chos bzhin mi 'grub mi srid/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang dngos/ /mngon sum mi yi gzugs su byon pa/ /'jam mgon bla ma legs pa'i mtshan can/ /grogs po khyod kyi rigs bdag lags pas/ /kha zhe mngon lkog med pa'i dad pas/ /ci mdzad khyed shes blo gtad ngang nas/ /nyin mtshan kun tu gsol ba 'debs pa/ /nyams len chos kyi snying por 'dzin dgos/ /bdag kyang rje btsun bla ma 'di la/ /sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skyes nas/ /'di phyi'i blo gtad khong la bcol bas/ /phyi ma'i lam rgyags cung zad rnyed yod/ /khyed kyang yid ches mos gus bskyed la/ /blo phug bla ma 'di la gtod dang / /byin rlabs thugs rjes bslu ba med pa'i/ /nyams myong tshad ma nga la yod lags/

/rang mgo thon pa'i gdeng drod med bzhin/ /gzhan mgo 'don pa'i snying stobs 'chang ba/ /nga dang nga 'dra'i bla ma gzhan la/ /skyabs su song yang phan pa 'byung dka'/ /snying nas lha chos mdzad par dgongs tshe/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba dug bzhin spangs nas/ /dben pa'i gnas su sgrub la gzhol ba/ /chos mdzad snga ma'i rnam thar lags mod/ /sna tshogs rkyen ngan rlung ltar 'tshub pa'i/ /shin tu rgud pa'i dus ngan 'di ru/ /'jig rten bya ba thams cad bzhag nas/ /chos sgrub zer ba dka' bar 'dug pas/ /thugs rgyud byang chub sems kyis sbyangs te/ /bya ba che chung ci byed thams cad/ /gzhan phan sems kyis zin par mdzad na/ /don gnyis 'bad med shugs kyis 'grub 'ong / /'phral phugs bya ba gang la 'jug kyang / /phyi rjes ring du lta ba gnad yin/ /sgrub kyang grub dus nam yang med pa'i/ /'dun ma'i thog mar brtag dpyad mdzad dgos/ /gzhungs bzang phyi thag can gyi grogs la/ /blo gtad mdzad na bslu ba med mod/ /khe nyen brtsi ba'i snyigs ma'i grogs kyis/ /nam yang bslu ba khyed kyis los mkhyen/ /gnas grogs longs spyod gang la bsams kyang / /skyo ba skye ba'i rgyu las med pas/ /chos med kun dga' bdag gi sems pa/ /dben pa'i ri la dga' ba de lags/ /ha cang bsam pa'i mtha' rgya bskyed na/ /rang sdug rin gyis nyo ba srid pas/ /dus dang bstun pa'i thabs mkhas ngang nas/ /blo sna 'phral chod mdzad na dga' 'am/ /bdag la yon tan chen po med rung / /mi chos 'dun ma mkhas pa'i gral du/ /'khor slob phal cher brtsi bar 'dug kyang / /bsam bzhin grub dus de snga ma byung / /bsgrubs na 'grub nges lha chos yin pas/ /mi tshe lhag ma cung zad 'di la/ /'chi khar mi 'gyod tsam zhig re ba/ /yang yang snying gi dkyil nas dran byung / /snying grogs khyed kyis de tshul dgongs la/ /'di phyi'i khe nyen zhib tu brtags nas/ /bya ba che chung gang la 'jug kyang /

/legs nyes 'dam ga nor du mi rung / /'di bzhin byas na 'di byung snyam pa'i/ /re dogs rtog pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'di yis/ /bdag ni sngon chad yang yang bslus pas/ /khyod kyang 'di yis bslu dogs mdzad dgos/ /rnam dkar dge tshogs gang zhig bsgrubs kyang / /dkon mchog gsum la yid ches bskyed nas/ /tshe rabs kun tu chos la spyod pa'i/ /smon lam 'debs pa gnad kyi don yin/ /sbyor dngos rjes kyis zin pa med na/ /ltar snang chos des phan pa chung bas/ /sems bskyed bsngo ba'i bar du btsud pa'i/ /chos dang rang sems sbyor ba gal che/ /grogs po khyed kyis mdzad pa'i spros pa/ /nges par bskyur te gnas dus byung tshe/ /sangs rgyas dngos 'dra'i bla ma mchog las/ /dbang bskur thob pa'i yi dam zhig la/ snying nas blo gtad chig dril mdzad de/ /nyin mtshan kun tu brtson pa mdzad dgos/ /de yang nyams len gnad du khel ba'i/ /man ngag snying pos zin pa gal che/ /bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong tshe/ /byin rlabs bkag kyang mi kheg 'jug yong / /snying la bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs tshe/ /chos dang rang sems gting nas 'dres yong / /sems rgyud chos dang 'dres par gyur na/ /shi yang 'gyod pa med pa lags so/ /bdag nyid gces 'dzin 'gong po thul na/ /dgra 'dre'i snang ba dbyings su dengs 'gro/ /kun la byams brtse lhag bsam 'byongs tshe/ /kun kyang byams pa'i gnyen du 'gyur 'ong / /nga rgyal khengs pa'i rwa rtse bcad na/ /rtag tu rang gis dman sa zin 'gro/ /'gro kun spyi bos thod bzhin bkur na/ /'gran sems rtsod pa'i brel zing mi 'ong / /bag yangs ngang du dge la brtson na/ /phyi ma'i lam rgyags tshags su tshud 'gro/ /grags snyan 'dod pa'i re ba chad na/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis thongs yong / /nam 'chi cha med snying la dran tshe/ /lha chos ngam ngam shugs kyis 'grub 'gro/ /las 'bras bslu med sems la bzung na/

/tshe rabs kun tu chos dang 'phrad 'ong / /dge bcu'i lam gyi them skas btsugs na/ /lha yul bgrod pa thang ring ma red/ /byang chub sems kyi lam bzang bsten na/ /sangs rgyas sgrub pa dka' rgyu ci yod/ /dam tshig sdom pa'i gshog rtsal rgyas na/ /mkha' spyod bgrod pa sus kyang nus 'ong / /gsang chen zab mo'i man ngag bsten na/ /'og min gnas kyang 'di na 'dug skad/ /zab mo bla ma'i lam la brtson na/ /thugs yid dbyer med nyams rtogs rgyas 'ong / /snying nas brtse ba'i grogs po khyed la/ /snying gtam bris te phul ba de lags/ /snying gi dkyil du sba bar mdzod dang / /snying po'i gdams pa yin par sems so/ /khyed kyi sku tshe mtha' ru phyin cing / /thugs bzhed mtha' dag lhun gyis 'grub ste/ /mi tshe skyid kyis 'khyongs par 'gyur ba'i/ /smon 'dun snying nas bdag gis zhu 'o/ /rigs sngags 'dzin pa'i khu byug sngon po/ /sna tshogs rkyen ngan lhags pas gdungs tshe/ /sman ljongs dben pa'i nags tshal dran nas/ /gsung ngag bsdams nas ldem ldem yod lags/ /gal te bsam don thog tu khel nas/ /sgrub la gzhol ba'i skal bzang rnyed tshe/ /khyed kyang yang dag lam du tshud pa'i/ /dngos grub lha dang bla mar zhu'o/ /zhes grogs mchog dam pa bkra shis chos ldan gyi bzhed skong du chos smra ba'i gzugs brnyan kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis bris pa dge'o// ༈ /brtse ba'i gnyen gcugs sems kyi rten phur/ /yid kyi 'khri shing snying gi thig le/ /mi dbang gdugs dkar snyan gyi lam du/ /bden gtam zangs ma phul ba 'di lags/ /rang gis 'bad nas bsags pa min yang / /pha khu bzang po byung ba'i lag rjes/ /lha dang mnyam pa'i bde skyid thob pa/ /sngon bsags bsod nams yin pa los dgongs/ /ha cang mnga' thang rgyas par gyur na/ /de la rgud pa shin tu nye bas/ /rang tshod zin pa'i thabs mkhas gyis la/ /mi tshe skyid kyis 'khyongs par mdzod cig

/dkon mchog gsum po 'di tsam ma gtogs/ /snying nas blo gtad 'pher ba med pas/ /skyid sdug gnas skabs ci 'dra byung yang / /mchog gsum bla ma sems kyis ma 'dor/ /da lta'i dus kyi mi chen phal cher/ /rkun mas dpon sa bzung ba mang bas/ /mna' dge med pa'i khram pa rnams la/ /rnam pa kun tu blo gtad ma mdzad/ /kha bshad tshe na nyin byed 'char yang / /lag len dus na mun mgo rub nas/ /khong shed med pa'i kha dpa' 'don pa/ /da lta'i skye bos bshad tshul red lags/ /zas gos nor gyis ngo bsrung dgos pa'i/ /gnyen bshes rnams la snying po med pas/ /rgyu 'bras bslu med sems na yod pa'i/ /bzang po'i grogs la brten pa gal che/ /cung zad legs na nga rgyal skye zhing / /phran tsheg nyes na sems rtsa zhum pa/ /dpa' brtan skye bo'i spyod pa min pas/ /rnam pa kun tu snying stobs bskyed dgos/ /ha cang byams na dbang du mi 'du/ /rtsub spyod kho nas dgra ru ldang bas/ /'jam rtsub bya ba ji ltar byas kyang / /phyi rjes ring du lta ba gnad lags/ /dpa' rtsal spyang grung 'dzoms pa lags kyang / /bsod nams med na bde ba mi thob/ /bsod nams bsags na bde skyid dpal 'byor/ /shugs kyis 'grub pa chos nyid lags so/ /lha sras khyod kyis tshul 'di dgongs la/ /blo stobs bskyed la lha chos mdzod dang / /thugs bzhed mtha' dag lhun gyis grub nas/ /mi chos phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /sems la rang don phugs su bcug nas/ /byams sdang log par ston pa'i skye bos/ /'phral du lus ngag gus par 'dug kyang / /sgrin po'i blo yis brtag dpyad dgos so/ /bcos ma'i spyod lam lus 'khyugs ldem zhing / /sku zhabs rje zhes gus pas 'bod pa'i/ /khram pa'i tshig la snying po ci yod/ /nyams nyes byung tshe khyed kyis gzigs 'ong / /nyam thag mgon med sprang po'i tshogs la/ /rang gi lag gis sbyin pa gtong zhing / /nga rgyal med pa brtse bas skyong ba/

/ya rabs dra ma'i mdzad pa los yin/ /pha khu bzang po sku tshe brtan cing / /rang yang na gzhon rig pa rno bas/ /da lta bag yangs ngang la ma bzhugs/ /rgyal srid btsan pa'i thabs la 'bad mdzod/ /da lta'i stobs 'byor 'di bas lhag zhig /dus kyi dbang gis 'ong bar dka' bas/ /mal sa non pa'i thabs mkhas shes na/ /bdag la zhu don de las med lags/ /spre 'us byed spyod sna tshogs shes kyang / /rang rtsa'i mdud pa bshig la mi mkhas/ /kha bshad shes kyang lag len med pa'i/ /mi ngan bdag kyang de dang 'dra lags/ /ma rgan nyam thag 'chi ba'i tshe na/ /bu 'dis dam pa'i chos shig 'grub tshe/ /bdag la bsam rgyu de las med ces/ /a ma'i zhal chems de 'dra gnang yang / /las ngan bdag ni rkyen gyi dbang gis/ /bsam ngan rtog pa'i 'khrul 'khor bskor nas/ /mi ngan rnams dang rgyun du 'grogs pas/ /'di phyi gnyis med 'di 'dra red song / /brtse ba'i ma dang sring mo la sogs/ /yid gcugs bdag gi gnyen bshes phal cher/ /dbang med las kyi rlung gis ded nas/ /phyi ma'i lam chen blangs nas lang song / /bral ba'i sdug bsngal shin tu che yang / /da ni gar yod tsam yang mi shes/ /skyid sdug gnas skabs ci 'dra yod snyam/ /sems ni shin tu skyo bar 'dug lags/ /snying gi me tog gzhon nu khyed la/ /da dung zhu rgyu mang po 'dug rung / /'brel med gtam la 'bras bu med pas/ /yi ges 'jigs nas de las ma bris/ /yid 'ong sa 'dzin mthon po'i rked pa/ /sngon byon dam pa gong ma'i gdan sa/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ /'du ba'i gnas mchog yid 'ong dgon pa/ /lha shing shugs pa'i yal ga'i khrod nas/ /lha bya 'jol mo'i glu dbyangs len cing / /dkar dmar lang tsho'i gzi mdangs bkra ba'i/ /mi tog sna tshogs rgyan bzhin bkram la/ /skad snyan bung ba'i bu mo'i tshogs rnams/ /'chi med lam du brtse zhing lding ba/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i rba rlabs bzhin du/

/lo yag snye ma rlung gis bskyod cing / /yid 'ong phyogs kyi tha gru thams cad/ /ri dwags g.yung dag du mas gang zhing / /bya tshogs mang po'i snyan glus bzung ba'i/ /sngo ljang ljon pa'i phreng bas bskor ba/ /char sprin mthing nag rnam par g.yo zhing / /'brug sgra zab mo dal gyis dgod bzhin/ /zim bu'i char gyis dga' ba sbyin pa'i/ /yid 'ong nyams dga'i gnas mchog de ru/ /dge bshes phrin las 'phel rgyas mchog gi /gzim khang bkra shis mthong smon nang nas/ /bsam yas rdzu 'phrul stobs kyi bdag po/ /gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i brgyud pa/ /phyogs bzhi'i dgra mgo dus gcig non pa'i/ /mes po stag gzig lta bu'i tsha bo/ /lugs gnyis mkhyen dpyod spobs pa mtho ba/ /pha khu cang shes lta bu'i bu brgyud/ /sna tshogs gzhung lugs mang du mthong ba'i/ /blo ldan zhig gis bris pa 'dra 'o/ /a la don med tshig tshogs mang po 'di/ /a gdugs khyed kyi mkhyen pa'i spyan lam du/ /a 'jam zhes bya'i kha yangs yig yangs des/ /a mtshar rtse mo'i tshul du phul ba lags// ༈ /gang zhig snying nas gus pa yis/ /bsten na nam yang mi bslu ba'i/ /dpal mgon rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /dang ba'i yid kyis phyag bgyis nas/ /tshig gi me tog las 'ong zhing / /don gyi ro bcud ma nyams pa'i/ /yid 'ong gdams pa'i 'bras bu 'di/ /khyod la sbyin gyis gus pas longs/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan gyi/ /nyi ma nub kyi ri rtser 'dzegs/ /sdug bsngal mun pas phyogs kun tu/ /khyab pa'i snyigs ma'i dus ngan 'dir/ /yang dag lam bzang 'doms pa yi/ /dge ba'i bshes dang mjal dka' bas/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rnyed pa'i tshe/ /mnyam 'grogs log lta mi 'chor bar/ /dbul pos nor bu rnyed pa ltar/ /shin tu dkon pa'i 'du shes kyis/ /dam pa snga ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis bsten par mdzod/ /le lo can la lung rtogs kyi/ /yon tan 'byung ba mi srid pas/

/mgo la me shor bzlog 'dra ba'i/ /gus dang rtag pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /dang por thos pa'i rgya mtsho la/ /spro ba'i yid kyis 'jug par mdzod/ /blang dor 'byed pa'i blo gros kyi/ /'dren byed gsal bar gyur pa'i tshe/ /sgro skur gtam gyis las ngan gyi/ /khur po 'degs la mi phyogs par/ /gang shes chos kyi gnad don rnams/ /rang gi rgyud la sbyor bar mdzod/ /shin tu gdul dka'i rang sems 'di/ /dam pa'i chos kyis thul ba'i tshe/ /bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / /pha ma'i drin lan 'khor ba dang / /dal 'byor snying po lon pa rnams/ /chabs cig 'byung ba ma lags sam/ /gzhon nu khyod la zhu 'os pa'i/ /skabs don shin tu mang na yang / /las ngan bdag ni mi khom pa'i/ /gzhan dbang drag pos mnar 'dug pas/ /da lan mdor du bsdus pa la/ /re zhig khyod kyis bzod par mdzod/ /khyod gsung mi bzlog tsam zhig tu/ /blo gros gzhan phan zla ba yis/ /gang shar yi ge'i lam bzang por/ /spel 'di dus kun dge gyur cig/ ༈ /phrin chos rang yul du 'byon skabs zhal gdams gnang ba bzhugs so// rje rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs can/ /skyabs bka' drin mtshungs med chos kyi rje/ /pha 'jam mgon ngag gi dbang po la/ /snying rus pa'i gting nas skyabs su mchi/ /mgon de yi thugs kyis rjes su bzung / /sgos dad brtson shes rab mchog mnga' ba/ /mi bdag la blo gtad 'cha' ba yi/ /grogs khyod kyi thugs la 'di ltar chongs/ /dus snyigs ma'i sems can bsod nams chung / /chos rnam dag sgrub pa nyin skar tsam/ /rkyen ngan pa'i dbang du mi 'chor bar/ /grogs khyed kyis blo sna stungs par mdzod/ /gnas mi med dben pa'i ri khrod du/ /sems rtse gcig sgrub la gzhol nus na/ /dus ha cang yun ring ma yin par/ /mi khyod kyis btsan sa zin snyam byed/ /sngon byon pa'i skyes mchog de dag gis/ /chos dang po rang gis nyams len mdzad/

/rang mi 'ching gzhan la phan pa'i tshe/ /thugs brtse bas 'gro don mdzad pa lags/ /don de phyir dam pa gong ma yis/ /chos bslab gsum bstan pa'i srog bzung nas/ /thugs brtse bas sems can ma bor bas/ /don gnyis po mtha' ru phyin pa mang / /dpal don grub gling gi dgon pa ru/ /khong grub chen ngag dbang bsam gtan dang / /rje kun dga' dpal 'byor la sogs pa/ /nyams rtogs pa'i dbang phyug gyur pa yi/ /mkhas grub kyi bla ma mang po byon/ /da dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar la/ /yid 'dun pa rtse gcig gtad nas ni/ /dus phyir bshol dbang du mi 'chor bar/ /da sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs re ran/ /rje bla ma sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal/ /chos zab dgu'i gdams pa thob dus 'dir/ /da rang gis nyams len ma mdzad na/ /dus phyis su 'gyod pas gdungs te 'chi/ /skyabs bla ma dkon mchog gtsug tu khur/ /chos byang chub sems la blo sbyangs nas/ /gnas dben pa'i ri khrod 'dzin pa la/ /thugs spro bar mdzod cig snying gi bu/ /mi bdag gi kha pho ma yin te/ /pha bla ma'i lung bstan khyod la yod/ /sems gus pas dang du blangs gyur na/ /don bslu ba med pa'i snying gtam yin/ /sprang bdag ni rnam g.yeng le lo dang / /sems phyir bshol dbang du song nas ni/ /rten dal 'byor don med shor song yang / /da 'gyod kyang bya thabs bral nas 'dug /mi kho bos gsar rnying ris med kyi/ /mgon dge ba'i bshes gnyen bcu phrag gnyis/ /tshul gus pas bsten nas zab mo'i chos/ /thos bsam la brtson khul bgyis pas na/ /tshig smras pa 'di la phyogs lhung dang / /rang 'dod dang blun gtam ma mchis pas/ /de thugs la chongs la dus myur du/ /da sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs par mdzod/ /dus nam zhig sgrub pa mthar phyin nas/ /blo mi 'jig gdeng drod rnyed pa'i tshe/ /khong re ltos can gyi gdul bya la/ /thugs brtse bas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /don de bzhin khyod kyis mdzad gyur na/

/rten dal 'byor don yod 'gyur ba dang / /rje bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa zhig /dus myur du 'byung ba'i smon 'dun zhu/ /da sku tshe sgrub pa mthar phyin nas/ /tshe 'di phyi kun tu 'phrad pa dang / /chos byang chub snying po ma thob bar/ /lar 'bral ba med pa'i smon 'dun zhu// //dge'o// ༈ /tshe mgon bla ma thar li la gnang ba bzhugs so// bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma la/ /sgo gsum gus pa'i tshul gyis phyag bgyis nas/ /dus gsum gzigs pa'i bla ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /bslab gsum 'dzin pa khyod la 'di skad zhu/ /dal 'byor mi lus lan gcig thob dus 'dir/ /rnam g.yeng le lo'i dbang du mi gtang bar/ /rtse gcig dam chos sgrub la gzhol ba ni/ /chos mdzad skyes bu snga ma'i rnam thar lags/ /rgyal kun snying rje'i rang gzugs spyan ras gzigs/ /grogs mchog khyod kyis yi dam mdzad nas ni/ /dka' spyad drag pos byang chub sgrub pa la/ /bdag ni snying nas rjes su yi rang ngo / /pha mar gyur pa'i 'gro ba 'di rnams kyi/ /sdug bsngal thams cad myur du zhi ba'i phyir/ /bdag gis sgo gsum chos la sbyor snyam pa'i/ /lhag bsam bzang po rgyun du bskyed par mdzod/ /bdag gis da ltar lus ngag yid gsum gyi/ /dka' spyad spro bas dang du blang pa 'dis/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal mtha' dag zhi nas ni/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i skal pa yod par smon/ /gzhan gyi don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi/ /smon sems 'di dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing / /dge ba che chung ji bsags thams cad kun/ /gzhan gyi don du bsngo ba gnad 'gag yin/ /lus sems gnyis la sdug bsngal gang byung yang / /tshul 'dis rigs drug 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal 'byung 'gyur kun gyi go bcad nas/ /kun kyang bde bar gyur zhes smon lam bya/ /mi dge'i rnam rtog mang po skye ba'i dus/ /dran shes ldan pas lhod par skyong shes na/

/'khrul rtog ngan pa'i rgyu 'grul chad nas ni/ /dam chos sgrub la spro ba ngang gis skye/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /kha zhe med pa'i dad pa'i gdung shugs kyis/ /nyin mtshan kun tu gsol ba 'debs nus na/ /bsam don thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par 'gyur/ /mdor na dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du/ /bla ma dran pa'i mos gus 'di yod na/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la zhugs nas ni/ /gnas lugs rang ngo shes pa'ang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /khyad par rang nyid 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /bla ma dran pa'i mos gus ma shor na/ /phyi ma dag pa'i zhing du skye ba yi/ /rgyu yi gtso bo yin par gsung pa'ang yod/ /kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar ji bzhin du/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don chen byed snyam nas/ /bzang po spyod pa'i mdo 'di zhal 'don du/ /yang yang mdzad na tshogs gnyis zung 'jug yin/ /dus dang dus su rang gi sems rgyud la/ /yang yang brtags nas mi dge kun spangs te/ /byang chub sems la 'dris goms byed pa ni/ /gnad don snying por dril ba'i man ngag yin/ /de ltar byas nas grogs mchog khyod nyid kyang / /'chi tshe rang la 'gyod pa mi 'byung bar/ /dag pa'i zhing du rgyal ba sras bcas dang / /mjal nas chos la spyod pa'i smon 'dun zhu/ zhes pa'ang sprul ming a 'jam pas bris pa dge/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sde ston a 'jam/ skyes mchog rnams la gdams pa'i skor/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
